saw_lines: Frozen pizza buyers pick on taste and price in seconds, then reorder the one they trust without comparing again.
So the sale is won or lost in the opening line, before the buyer decides whether to keep reading.
Your 13 of 27 copy ads open on the same line, so one opener carries the account. Write three new openers from your Salami Sensation win and test them.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 24 Nov 2026
points: 13 of your 27 copy ads open on the same line, so one opener carries the whole account. A repeated hook leaves taste and price unanswered. Write three new openers from your Salami Sensation win and test them.
The offer appears after 97% of the copy on a median ad of 65 words, so few viewers reach it. Only 3 of your 27 ads mention an offer. Open every ad with the delivery promise in the first two lines.
One exact copy runs in 13 of your 27 ads, so buyers see identical words over and over. Keep that copy, but change the opening line and creative in each ad, so every ad looks new.

6 of your 27 ads are creator posts with codes and #ad tags, yet they run from the brand page. Whitelist them from each creator account so the posts keep their original voice, then cut three variations of each one.
